name: Marriage Proposals
short: Everything you need to create a proposal that feels intimate, effortless and unforgettable.
statement: For the moments that change everything.
intro: From the first glass of Champagne to the moment you ask the question, we take care of every detail.
Beautiful settings, fresh flowers, thoughtful styling and a setting designed around your story. You arrive; the rest is already waiting.

options.name: The Basic Set
options.text: Seasonal fruit, a beautifully prepared blanket, Moët & Chandon and a bouquet of flowers: everything you need to turn a simple moment into an unforgettable proposal.

options.name: The Decorated Arch
options.text: An elegant floral arch with LED letters, designed to make the moment stand out while creating a romantic, timeless atmosphere. Various phrases available.

options.name: Picnic & Arch
options.text: A beautifully curated picnic paired with the floral arch and LED letters, for a proposal or a celebration to remember.

options.name: The Diamond Experience
options.text: For those looking for something truly extraordinary. A proposal designed from the ground up around your vision, with a dedicated concierge, a private driver, exclusive locations, bespoke décor, culinary experiences and photography.

included: A first conversation to understand your story
Location scouting and timing for the best light
Styling with flowers, linen and candlelight
Champagne for the moment after the question

seo.title: Marriage proposals in Comporta, Lisbon and Portugal · Picnic Club
seo.description: Intimate, effortless marriage proposals on the beaches of Comporta, Tróia, Melides and Lisbon, styled with flowers, linen and candlelight.
